boundaries: Routine entry to actual caller return fetch; inclusive elapsed includes children/DMA/interrupts. Exclusive active subtracts child routines, DMA and OnlineNmi service, while retaining inline MVN CPU/bus cost. Non-DMA non-interrupt activity includes SNES bus waits and DRAM refresh, not nominal instruction-only cycles. NMI hardware/vector dispatch before OnlineNmi is not independently isolated and stays within its scoped caller interval. DMA completion at first post-DMA instruction as in certified control. Inline/MVN and fused regions are diagnostic subsets, not extra terms in the production sum.
measurement_uncertainty: Exclusive active master clocks include CPU bus waits and DRAM refresh; no nominal instruction-only CPU-cycle claim.

NMI service is observed at OnlineNmi entry to restored caller PC/SP, after hardware/vector dispatch. Dispatch before that entry is not separately isolated; it remains inside the scoped preflight interval. Warm NMIs are all inside preflight and do not explain the formerly-other residual.
DMA intervals use the established write-to-first-post-DMA-instruction boundaries and include the first post-DMA instruction, rather than claiming an exact DMA-only electrical interval.
Caller glue is localized to explicit assembly regions but not individually attributed by opcode; maximum individual loop-iteration costs are not claimed.
